summary: Former Forest Service lookout in Laurel County, KY, built in the 1930s; site is now the Bald Rock Picnic Area. Sources disagree on removal (1970 vs mid-1970s).

facts.design: Tower with a cabin; type not given
facts.status_note: Tower removed; the site is now the Forest Service's Bald Rock Picnic Area

access.note: Forest Service picnic area on the former site; no source restricts entry

visit.trail_note: Picnic area off KY 192 north of Laurel River Lake

events.note: Forest Service gives 1936 as the start of the tower on this site; the Register says only the 1930s
A 1950 survey description places a survey disk near the lookout tower
Forest Service says the tower stood until 1970; the Register says removed in the mid-1970s
Registered June 19, 2017 as US 1701, KY 4; nominated by Robert Wittenback

evidence.supports: location: Daniel Boone National Forest, Laurel County
built in the 1930s and removed in the mid-1970s (Register)
evidence.quote: Bald Rock Lookout was built in the 1930s and removed in the mid-1970s.

evidence.supports: administered by the U.S. Forest Service
former site now maintained by USFS as a picnic area
evidence.quote: Its former site is now maintained by the US Forest Service as Bald Rock Picnic Area.

evidence.supports: part of tower and cabin used as a press box, since removed
evidence.quote: part of this tower and cabin were used as a press box at South Laurel High School but they have since been removed

evidence.supports: 1950 survey description by Coast and Geodetic Survey
evidence.quote: DESCRIBED BY COAST AND GEODETIC SURVEY 1950 (LWS)

evidence.supports: survey station near the lookout tower, north side of Highway 192
evidence.quote: ROCK LOOKOUT TOWER AND ON THE NORTH SIDE OF STATE HIGHWAY 192

evidence.supports: tower stood on the site from 1936 to 1970
evidence.quote: From 1936 to 1970, the Bald Rock Fire Lookout Tower stood on this site.

evidence.supports: picnic area off KY 192 north of Laurel River Lake
evidence.quote: Bald Rock Picnic Area is located off KY 192 north of Laurel River Lake

evidence.supports: two large and two small picnic sites; volleyball and horseshoes
evidence.quote: There are two large picnic sites and 2 small ones. Volleyball and horseshoes are available.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Service says the tower stood until 1970; the Register says it was removed in the mid-1970s. The story reports both and does not choose one.

notes_for_editor: Location, builder and picnic-area reuse agree across the three sources. Removal year conflicts (1970 per Forest Service, mid-1970s per Register) and the story says so. The 1950 survey description is from a Forest Lookouts transcript of an NGS datasheet; the datasheet itself was not fetched. No photo URL was in the fetched text (the Register's photo credit to Robert Wittenback has no link), so none added. No corrections to the brief: its 1970 removal date is now supported by the Forest Service page.
